summary: Copy text, code, or a link to the clipboard using an on-screen copy or share control.
preconditions: The target content (such as a code block, translation, or shareable item) is visible on the screen.
steps: Locate the target content block or item on the page.
Find the associated copy control (often labeled 'Copy', 'Copy Link', 'Share', or represented by a clipboard/link icon) near or inside the content container.
If a share menu or modal opens, click the secondary 'Copy' or 'Copy Link' button within that menu.

variants.when: The copy button is not immediately visible
variants.do: Hover the mouse cursor over the content block to reveal hidden overlay controls.

variants.when: Copying a URL or sharing link
variants.do: Click the 'Share' button first to open the sharing options, then click 'Copy Link'.

watch_for: The copy button text changing to 'Copied!' or displaying a checkmark icon.
A temporary toast notification or popup confirming the content has been copied to the clipboard.
completion_signal: The copy control displays a confirmed/success state, or a confirmation message appears on screen.
pitfalls: Clicking the wrong copy button when multiple content blocks or items are displayed on the same page.
Assuming the content is copied by just clicking 'Share' without clicking the subsequent 'Copy' option in the dropdown or modal.
